property_summary: For every call to fallback, the reference contract accepts (does not revert) the call iff msg.value == 10 ether; the mutant requiring 5 ether breaks this rule for some fuzzed msg.value inputs (some values cause the reference to accept but the mutant to revert, and vice versa).
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when fallback accepts and updates pastBlockTime and potentially when funds are transferred.
